name: Tsutsumi Packaging
description: Tsutsumi Packaging — a theme for a packaging manufacturer (mailer boxes, shipping cartons, folding cartons, trays, sleeves and dividers), built around a spec catalogue: a formal header with the company name, the Request samples button and a menu button that opens a full-screen amber overlay. Amber (#CA7A2C) is the main colour: the lower half of the first screen, the sample request band, the menu overlay and the page heads are amber. The front page opens on a full-bleed kraft-board texture with a one-line Kosugi Maru headline and a solid amber Request samples button; below it a white spec table card straddles the amber field with six product rows (cut-out product photograph, type, size range, board grade, minimum lot, lead time). Below: five board swatches with grade codes and recycled content beside a photograph of the board edges, a four-step custom-order flow in one line (spec, sample, proof, run) with amber step numbers on an ink field, certifications and tests as a two-column table scrolling beside a sticky factory photograph, a die-line and spec-sheet download list and an amber sample request band where a cut-out stack of boxes breaks over the top edge. Photographs are realistic low-key images (50mm f/1.4, single hard window light, deep shadows, graded toward amber) and studio cut-outs. Kosugi Maru for headings, Epilogue for text and figures. Sample content in English. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
